title: How to Get a Job at CRED in 2026: Open Roles, Interviews and Tips
excerpt: Where CRED is hiring in October 2026, what its job posts ask for, what candidates report about interviews, and the perks and ESOPs it offers new hires.
content:
To get a job at CRED in 2026, apply through its careers site, careers.cred.club, which pulls every opening from a Lever job board. On 4 October 2026 that board had just eight roles, all full-time and on-site. Seven were in Bengaluru and one was in Hyderabad, and none were in engineering. 100Xfounder is an independent site and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CRED. This guide covers where CRED is hiring, what its job posts ask for, what candidates report about interviews and how to prepare.

Key takeaways

  • CRED's public Lever board listed eight open roles on 4 October 2026: seven in Bengaluru and one in Hyderabad, all full-time and on-site.
  • The openings are in business development, payments, growth, writing and finance. There were no engineering, design or data roles on the public board that day.
  • Most posts ask for four or more years of experience, and the senior payments and partnerships roles ask for six to twelve.
  • Founder Kunal Shah left in June 2026 to run WhatsApp at Meta, which invested $900 million in CRED. Miten Sampat is interim CEO.
  • Candidate reports for engineering roles describe a take-home or online coding test, problem-solving and design rounds, and a final round with a senior leader. These are individual accounts, not an official process.

What CRED does and what changed in 2026

CRED started in 2018 as a rewards app for paying credit card bills. It now offers payments, lending, insurance, wealth management and lifestyle services to 17 million monthly active users, according to Entrackr. The same report says CRED handles more than 40% of India's credit card bill payments. Its operating revenue for the year to March 2025 (FY25) rose 16% to ₹2,735 crore, and its operating loss fell 51% to ₹298 crore. One crore is ₹10 million, so that revenue is about ₹27.4 billion.

The big change came on 22 June 2026. Meta agreed to invest $900 million in CRED at a post-money valuation of about $4.5 billion, and named Kunal Shah as WhatsApp's new chief executive, TechCrunch reported. Miten Sampat, who joined CRED in 2020, became interim CEO. Shah remains a large shareholder but has stepped away from running the company.

For job seekers, the useful detail is what the money is for. In an interview with Moneycontrol in July 2026, Sampat said about $450–500 million of the deal would go to CRED's balance sheet. He named three priorities: scaling CRED's credit card business to a few million users, using AI more heavily, and running several separate apps, such as Kuvera and Cash by CRED. He also said CRED had recently reported its first profitable quarter.

Where CRED is hiring right now

CRED's openings page listed seven roles on 4 October 2026, all in Bengaluru. Its public Lever job board had eight, because it also carried a finance role in Hyderabad for Prefr, a lending business. Here is how the eight roles split by the team named on each posting:

Team (business unit)Open rolesRoles
Consumer products (product and growth)2Credit card bill payments growth; business development and partnerships
Business – CREDpay2Lead, on-deck payments; business development and strategic partnerships (D2C)
Business (VA Tech)1Business development and partnerships, commercial lead
Brand strategy (marketing)1Copywriter
Public relations (corporate and business strategy)1Long-form content writer/editor
Finance (Prefr)1Accounts payable manager, Hyderabad

All eight were full-time and marked on-site. Six of them were posted after the Meta deal was announced on 22 June. The oldest, the copywriter role, had been open since November 2025.

Two of these units are not the main CRED app. VA Tech, formerly Happay, is CRED's business-to-business payments infrastructure company, according to its commercial lead posting. Prefr, run by CreditVidya, is a digital lending platform that offers personal loans of ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh, according to the accounts payable posting. One lakh is ₹100,000.

What if you are an engineer?

The public board had no engineering, design or data science openings on 4 October. That can change quickly, so check the board regularly. You can follow new CRED openings, refreshed from the official feed, on our CRED jobs page. For similar roles at other companies, browse engineering jobs in Bengaluru.

What CRED looks for

CRED does not publish a "how we hire" guide, but its values page and job posts make the bar clear.

Ownership with numbers attached

The credit card bill payments growth posting asks for four to seven years in user growth or category management, or three to five years in consulting, banking or strategy. It wants someone who has taken growth projects from idea to measured result. The role covers funnel metrics, A/B tests and reward campaigns judged on return on spend. The on-deck payments lead needs six to ten years in payments or fintech. It also asks for experience owning a profit and loss account and working within regulated payment rails.

Sellers, not relationship managers

The partnership roles are explicit about this. The D2C partnerships posting says it is a builder and seller role that carries a revenue quota. It asks for four or more years in quota-carrying sales or partnerships, plus an existing network among direct-to-consumer (D2C) founders. The VA Tech commercial lead asks for seven to twelve years. It wants proof that you have run a pipeline from first contact to signed deal with banks, NBFCs (non-bank lenders) or payment networks.

A point of view you can defend

The writing roles test judgement as much as craft. The copywriter posting wants someone who brings a point of view, can defend it, and gives direct feedback regardless of seniority. The long-form writer posting asks for a body of work across formats, experience writing in a founder's voice, and fintech, business or lifestyle editorial experience.

The values behind it

CRED's values page lists seven values, including "high agency", "fast & right" and "frugal". The page sums up high agency as "no passengers, no excuses". Sampat told Moneycontrol that former employees often say they miss CRED's talent density, meaning the concentration of strong people. In February 2025, before he left, Kunal Shah said a team sport or group game often shows cultural fit better than a formal interview, Business Today reported. That was a personal view, not a description of CRED's process.

The hiring process: what we know and what candidates report

CRED has not published a standard interview loop, and it almost certainly varies by team. Here is what is confirmed: you apply through the Lever posting, and every current role is full-time and on-site in a named city. Everything below comes from candidate reports on GeeksforGeeks. They date from 2022 to 2024 and cover engineering roles, so treat them as individual experiences, not a guarantee.

  1. An assignment or online test. An Android developer who interviewed for an SDE role described a take-home assignment with a 24-hour deadline (GeeksforGeeks, June 2022). A fresher applying for an automation engineer role reported a proctored online test on HackerRank of 105 minutes with three coding problems (GeeksforGeeks, September 2024).
  2. Problem-solving rounds. The Android candidate described a 90-minute data structures round written in a shared document, judged on approach and explanation. A second software developer report describes a technical interview on coding and engineering principles (GeeksforGeeks, May 2024).
  3. Domain and design. The Android candidate had a long round on platform fundamentals and app architecture. Both engineering reports include a system design round.
  4. A senior or culture conversation. Both reports end with a round on culture fit and career goals. In the Android account it was combined with design and led by an engineering head.

The Android candidate said every round had two interviewers. None of the reports we found give a reliable timeline from application to offer. We found no public candidate reports for the business, payments or writing roles that make up the current board. Glassdoor's CRED interview pages were not accessible when we checked, so we have not used them.

Interview focus by role

Without an official loop, use each job post as your guide.

  • Growth and category roles: bring funnel numbers you owned, experiments you ran and campaigns you stopped because the return was poor.
  • Payments roles: prepare to discuss regulated payment rails, partner banks and networks, and the trade-off between growth and cost to serve.
  • Partnerships and sales: bring a list of deals you sourced and closed, with sizes where you can share them, and the brands or banks you know well.
  • Writing roles: expect your portfolio to be the main test. Pick pieces that show range and a clear voice.
  • Finance (Prefr): the post asks for a chartered accountant with four to seven years of experience and working knowledge of Indian tax and company law (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act).

How to stand out

  1. Use the product seriously. CRED's careers footer says CRED members make better team members. Knowing how bill payments, rewards, UPI payments and the newer apps work, and where they fall short, gives you something concrete to talk about.
  2. Lead with measured outcomes. Almost every current post asks for a track record you can prove: quota delivered, metric moved or deals closed. Put numbers on your CV and be ready to explain how you got them.
  3. Match the experience band honestly. The current roles ask for three to twelve years. There were no internships or graduate roles on the board on 4 October, so early-career candidates should watch for new postings rather than stretch into senior ones.
  4. Know the business unit you are applying to. A VA Tech or Prefr role is a different company from the consumer app. Read the opening paragraph of each post and tailor your pitch to it.
  5. Plan for on-site work. Every role is on-site in Bengaluru or Hyderabad. CRED's perks page says it helps cover major relocation costs.

Pay, perks and offers

None of the eight postings show a salary range, and CRED does not publish pay bands. Figures on job forums and salary sites are not confirmed by the company, so we have left them out. What CRED does publish is a long list of benefits on its perks page:

  • Equity: employees receive ESOPs (employee stock options). Under an "accelerated wealth program", staff can take up to 50% of annual cash pay as special ESOP grants that vest fully in one year.
  • Liquidity: CRED says it runs ESOP buybacks from time to time. Entrackr reported that CRED announced its fifth buyback with the Meta round, after four earlier ones worth ₹250 crore in total.
  • Salary timing: salaries are paid at the start of each month. Two job posts add that new joiners are paid before their joining date.
  • Insurance: health cover with top-up options, ₹50 lakh of personal accident cover and term life cover of three times annual CTC.
  • Time and place: an open leave policy, no tracked working hours, lunch at the office and help with relocation.

Entrackr also reported, from company filings, that CRED expanded its ESOP pool with the Meta round. It estimated the full pool at about ₹5,000 crore ($526 million), or about 11.6% of fully diluted shares. ESOPs are worth something only if they can be sold, so ask how vesting and buybacks would apply to your grant.

Indian offers are usually quoted as yearly CTC (cost to company) in lakhs per annum (LPA). Before comparing an offer with your current pay, work out the monthly take-home with our in-hand salary calculator. If you need to leave a job early, the notice period buyout calculator estimates the cost. Tax rules change, so confirm the details with a qualified tax professional.

Bottom line

CRED is newly funded, under interim leadership and focused on credit cards, payments and AI. Its public hiring in October 2026 is narrow: eight experienced roles in business, payments, writing and finance, with no engineering openings on the board. If you fit one of those posts and can show measured results, apply directly and tailor your pitch to the specific business unit. Engineers and early-career candidates should watch the board for new roles.

FAQ

Does CRED hire freshers?

Not on the current board. On 4 October 2026 every one of the eight roles asked for experience, mostly four years or more. One 2024 candidate report describes a fresher test for an automation engineer role, so entry-level hiring has happened before.

Is CRED hiring software engineers in 2026?

There were no engineering roles on CRED's public Lever board on 4 October 2026. Openings change often, so check the official board or our CRED jobs page.

Can I work remotely at CRED?

Not in the current openings. All eight roles were marked on-site, seven in Bengaluru and one in Hyderabad.

What is CRED's interview process like?

CRED has not published one. Engineering candidate reports describe an assignment or online coding test, problem-solving and design rounds, and a final culture round with a senior leader. Business roles may differ.

Who runs CRED now?

Miten Sampat has been interim CEO since founder Kunal Shah became WhatsApp's chief executive in June 2026, according to TechCrunch.

Where do I apply?

Apply on CRED's official careers page, which links to each Lever posting, or browse our CRED jobs page. Never pay anyone for a referral or interview slot.
